en.name: Tutorial
en.description: Learn the game in a full battle.
en.tutorial.deploy.intro: This is the deployment stage. Your army is stacked on the left of your zone, grouped by type. Spread it across the zone before the battle starts — the layout you pick shapes how the fight begins.
en.tutorial.deploy.selectInfantry: Start with your line infantry. {input.selectUnits} over a block of them to draw a selection box.
en.tutorial.deploy.positionInfantry: Move them up to form the front line. {input.moveUnit} a selected unit to reposition it inside the zone.
en.tutorial.deploy.selectCavalry: Now grab your dragoons. {input.selectUnits} over them.
en.tutorial.deploy.positionCavalry: Place them behind your infantry line — kept in reserve they can charge through gaps or plug a break. {input.moveUnit} to reposition.
en.tutorial.deploy.positionArtillery: Push the guns forward, behind the line where they have range and line of sight. Artillery reaches the farthest — don't leave it exposed. {input.moveUnit} to reposition.
en.tutorial.deploy.selectSkirmishers: Last, pick up your skirmishers. {input.selectUnits} over them.
en.tutorial.deploy.positionSkirmishers: Tuck them near trees or broken ground. Skirmishers use cover to harass enemies from a distance, and they fold in melee — so keep them supported. {input.moveUnit} to reposition.
en.tutorial.deploy.confirm: When the line looks good, hit Submit orders to begin the battle.
en.tutorial.move.message: Right-click where you want a unit to go. Drag a box with left-click to grab a few of them at once. Head for the flags in the middle. That's what this fight is about.
en.tutorial.stamina.message: Running burns stamina. Tired units hit softer and rout faster. Walk into position and save the sprint for when it actually matters.
en.tutorial.shoot.message: Skirmishers and artillery shoot on their own once an enemy walks into range. Skirmishers hit hard at distance but fold in melee, so keep them behind your line. Artillery reaches the furthest. Don't let cavalry get close to it.
en.tutorial.charge.message: Hold Shift when you order a dragoon and it'll charge instead of walking in. A good charge can break an infantry line, but it wears your horses out fast. Pick the moment.
en.tutorial.objectives.message: Each flag you hold gives you Victory Points every turn and brings in manpower for replacements. Whoever ends the battle with more VP wins. That's the whole game.
en.tutorial.formation.message: A supported line is hard to break. Don't leave skirmishers or artillery on their own. One cavalry charge into an isolated unit is enough to end it. Screen with line infantry and anchor with artillery.
en.tutorial.morale.message: Units rout when their organization collapses. Losses, a flank attack, or plain exhaustion can all do it. A routing unit won't fight. Pull tired units back to recover and send fresh ones up.
en.tutorial.finalPush.message: Clock's almost out. Whoever has more VP when it hits zero wins. Pick the flag that decides it and throw everything at that one. Don't try to hold everywhere.
